notes.title: Patch 1.1 - Accessibility and fixes update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Empowered toxic shields powerups
[*] Empowered toxic magnets powerups
[*] Improved randomizer, because some powerups used to show up too often on some platforms. 
[*] Increased maximum enemies life
[*] Increased spawn rate at late stages. Game needs to conclude faster.
[*] After a lot of time, weaker enemies won't spawn anymore
[*] Powerup bundles unlock faster, to accomodate for game expansion
[*] As late game needs to conclude faster, and performance shall be hold in check, upgrade pixels will despawn faster with game progression.
[*] Enemy turrets now explode when collided with
[*] Added option for disabling screenshake
[*] Added option for disabling flashing screen
[/list]
